description_en: Queries the traffic and request counts for accelerated domain names at a 5-minute granularity in batches
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainMultiUsageData批量查询加速域名的流量和请求数类五分钟粒度的数据
name: DescribeDomainMultiUsageData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

You can specify up to 30 domain names in a single query.
If this parameter is left empty, the grouped data of all accelerated domain names is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

单次查询最多可添加30个域名。
若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名分组数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO 8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO 8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the queried usage data. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
EndTime.description_zh: 查询用量的结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

RequestDataModule.description_en: The list of request metering data for each 5-minute interval
RequestDataModule.description_zh: 每五分钟各请求计量数据列表

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time frame during which the requests are counted in the returned data. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
TimeStamp.description_zh: 返回数据中，请求数所在时间片段起始时刻。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

Type.description_en:
The type.

For Alibaba Cloud CDN, only Simple is supported

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the queried usage data. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
StartTime.description_zh: 查询用量的开始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

TrafficDataModule.description_en: The list of traffic metering data for each 5-minute interval
TrafficDataModule.description_zh: 每五分钟各流量计量数据列表

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time frame to which the usage data belongs in the returned data. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
TimeStamp.description_zh: 返回数据中，用量数据所在时间片段起始时刻。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

Type.description_en:
The type of requests. Valid values:

StaticHttps: HTTPS request for static content.
DynamicHttps: HTTPS request for dynamic content.
DynamicHttp: HTTP request for dynamic content.
StaticQuic: QUIC request for static content (resources).
DynamicQuic: QUIC request for dynamic content (resources)
Type.description_zh:
请求数类型。取值：

StaticHttps：静态HTTPS请求数。
DynamicHttps：动态HTTPS请求数。
DynamicHttp：动态HTTP请求数。
StaticQuic：静态QUIC请求数。
DynamicQuic：动态QUIC请求数
